sources.snippet: We present community-driven BERT, DistilBERT, ELECTRA, ConvBERT and T5 models for Turkish 🎉 Some datasets used for pretraining and evaluation are contributed from the awesome Turkish NLP community, as well as the decision for the BERT model name: BERTurk.
